description: Compare one caller-owned saved agent's current strategy with one proposed revision on one shared historical dataset and a chronological cold-state holdout. The response includes exact strategy hashes, fees, slippage, evidence completeness, and holdout deltas. It never reveals the saved source, changes the agent, promotes the candidate, signs, funds, or submits orders; applying a revision always requires a separate explicit update_agent call.

bars.description: Exact shared historical bars. Defaults to 600.

candidate_strategy_id.description: Owned Felix-generated candidate strategy UUID. Source code is never accepted.

capital.description: Fresh hypothetical capital for every replay phase. Defaults to 1000.

fee_bps_per_side.description: Execution fee applied to every simulated fill. Defaults to 5 bps.

holdout_fraction.description: Chronological cold-state holdout fraction. Defaults to 0.30.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable retry key. Reuse it after any timeout.

market.description: Required only when the saved agent authorizes multiple markets; it must be one of those markets.

min_holdout_trades.description: Minimum candidate holdout trades before the comparison is decision-usable. Defaults to 1.

objective.description: Holdout comparison objective. Defaults to return over drawdown.

slippage_bps_per_side.description: Adverse movement applied to every simulated fill. Defaults to 0 bps.

name: review_agent_strategy_revision
